senses.gloss: m.(b. h. יַחַשׂ; יָחַס)connection, family relation, v. חַיִיס I.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 15a:2">B. Kam. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דאין לו י׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="H00740"><he>חייס</he></cite>) because the slave has no legal relationship.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 2:6:3">Y. Yeb. II, 4ᵃ</cite> top <he>ועבדים יש להם ייחוס</he> (read <cite ref="J00303"><he>יַיחַס</he></cite>) have slaves legal pedigrees?—Pl. <he>יְחָסִים</he>, <he>יְחָסִין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 2:2:1">Y. Kidd. II, 62ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אם הטעה לשבח י׳</he> if he deceived her inasmuch as he proved of higher birth than he had presented to her.
